newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea says two suspected N.Korean agents killed.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea says two suspected N.Korean agents killed.

text.p: Two men suspected to be North Korean infiltrators were shot dead on Tuesday by South Korean troops, a South Korean military spokesman said.
The two men were killed near the border with North Korea, he said.
"We are not sure if the two killed today were from the submarine. Military investigators are looking into the matter," the spokesman said.
Tens of thousands of South Korean troops have been hunting for three missing North Koreans after a North Korean submarine landed 26 agents in September.

The Shark-class submarine ran aground off the eastern city of Kangnung on September 17 as it tried to pick up three spies it offloaded two days earlier, according to the only North Korean captured alive from the vessel.
Of the 26 North Koreans, 22 had earlier been shot dead after they fled into the surrounding hills.
